_comment: What each customer bought. Copy to orgs.json and keep it out of git.
directory.json says who works for which org; this says which hospitals
that org may read. Every route that takes ?ccn= is checked against it.
An org with no entry here sees nothing — the failure points at a support
ticket rather than at a breach.
minerva_admin holds org "*" and is not listed here; "*" is rejected.
A CCN listed under two orgs fails at startup, not at request time.
